programme.desc: Catch the latest news and social changes that are moving China and the world. (获取最新的新闻和社会变化,)

programme.title: Focus Today ((今日关注（中央电视台中文国际频道深度时事新闻评论栏目）))
programme.desc: The programme traces the latest development of the current affairs around China. (该计划追踪了中国当前事件的最新发展.)

programme.title: Around China ((电影眼漫游中国))
programme.desc: Enter a world where the true essence of China blossoms and you will begin to understand how this great nation has evolved. (进入一个中国真正的世界,你会开始理解这个伟大的国家是如何发展的.)

programme.title: Network News ((Network 收播新闻))
programme.desc: Network News is a 30-minute news program which features news on China and the world. (网络新闻是一个30分钟的新闻节目,)

programme.title: Classical Theatre ((中文))
programme.desc: This broad selection of drama series genres includes romance, military and family connections, captured in Chinas great classics. (这种广泛的戏剧系列类型包括浪漫,军事和家庭联系,)

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins ((摩登土佬))
programme.desc: This musical production features George Lam in a humorous tale of a man who seeks love and success in a world of TV commercials, along with his two friends. (这部音乐作品中,乔治·兰姆在一个幽默的故事中,)

programme.title: Brave Archer and His Mate ((神雕侠侣))
programme.desc: Fourth in the hugely popular series, the leader of Venom, supported by his fellow members and Brave Archer associates, sets out to defeat a mass murderer. (在这个非常受欢迎的系列中,第四位,威的领导人, 得到他的同事和勇敢的射箭员的支持,)

programme.title: Hong Kong 73 ((香港'73))
programme.desc: Families win and lose fortunes overnight while neighbours swindle each other as stock as speculation madness takes over Hong Kong. (家庭在一夜之间赢得和失去财富,而邻居互相欺骗,)

programme.title: Wits of the Brats ((南斗官三斗北少爷))
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng both co-stars and co-directs his brother Chang Chan-peng in this all-out action comedy featuring the best in the business. (亚历山大·福 (Alexander Fu Sheng) 共同演出并联合导演他的兄弟长·在这个全场动作喜剧中,)

programme.title: The Three Smiles ((三笑))
programme.desc: In this retelling of Chinas most popular romance, superstar Ivy Ling Po plays a scholar who tries to seduce a servant. (在这部重述中国最受欢迎的浪漫中,超级明星艾维波扮演了一个学者,)

programme.title: The Naval Commandos ((海军突击队))
programme.desc: Tony Liu, Ti Lung, Fu Sheng, David Chiang and Shih Szu star in this rousing epic of a near suicidal mission to destroy the Japanese Navys flagship in 1937.

programme.title: The Swordmates ((燕娘))
programme.desc: After a mans household pays dearly for his faith in his business rival, he turns to his swordmate and that mans son for help. (一个人的家人为他对他的商业竞争对手的信心付出了很高的代价,)

programme.title: The Fighting Fool ((夺棍))
programme.desc: Its Meng Yuan-wen versus Kuan Feng in this wild and wacky wushu saga about a priceless pole with a spectacular secret. (孟元与昆在这个疯狂的武士传说中,关于一个无价的极带着壮观的秘密.)

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake ((寒煙翠))
programme.desc: In this adapation of a Qiong Yao novel, a young woman finds lust, trouble, and, finally, happiness at a picturesque farm. (在这部改编的小说中,一个年轻女子在一家画画的农场发现欲望,麻烦,)

programme.title: Dirty Ho ((臭臭和脏脏))
programme.desc: Master martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang presents this brilliant kung fu comedy, incorporating, some of the best-executed fight sequences ever caught on film. (武术电影制作人 Chia-liang 介绍了这部烂的功夫喜剧,)

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil ((托德与邪恶之书))
programme.desc: When Fang returns from the U.S. to see Rose but starts eyeing her old friends fiance, Rose shows that she has a thorny side. (斯开始看着她老朋友的未婚夫,)

programme.title: Forever Diamonds ((007：金刚钻))
programme.desc: Ding, a con woman swindles a diamond ring off a rich man, but when it ends up in another mans hands, she now has to get it back. (,一个骗子把钻石戒指从一个富人身上偷走,)

programme.title: Till the End of Time ((直到永远))
programme.desc: A singer struggles against the odds to keep her career and marriage intact. Starring Jenny Hu, Peter Chen Ho. (一位歌手,为了保持自己的职业生涯和婚姻, 努力抵制各种困境.)

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra ((人蛇鼠))
programme.desc: Follow a virtuous viper as it sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a dangerous lady in this thriller! (随着一个美德的蛇 sniffs 炸弹,战斗帮派,战斗杀死婴儿的动物,甚至在这个惊片中,)

programme.title: The Delinquent ((斯文败类))
programme.desc: A hothead Wang Chung is tempted by the dark side in this coming-of-age tale which centres on c. 1970s lower-class Hong Kong teens. (这部故事中,一个热头王被黑暗面诱惑,)

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies ((女子公寓))
programme.desc: This comedy centres on the residents of a females-only apartment who hail from different backgrounds and make money in varied ways. (这部喜剧的故事是关于一个只有女性居住的公寓的居民,)

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death (与死亡的约会)
programme.desc: A master swordsman takes on a dangerous mission to guard a treasure chest on its way to Xi An. However, he stumbles upon a conspiracy (一个剑师在前往西安的路上承担着危险的任务,保护一个宝藏箱.)

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung ((乾隆皇奇遇记))
programme.desc: A kind Emperor lands himself in big trouble when he begins frequenting the gambling dens to learn what makes his subjects tick. Stars Anthony Lau, Wong Yue. (一位善良的皇帝在博场上开始去学习什么让他的臣民着.)

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer ((江湖了断))
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien, in the roles of criminal and cop. (追逐杀手的魅力在于五毒队的两人团结,洛孟和孙,)

programme.title: The Bride Napping ((花田错))
programme.desc: Betty Loh, Grace Ting and Diana Chang star in this romantic comedy between a gifted scholar and the administrative officials daughter he falls for at first sight. (贝蒂·洛,格雷斯·廷和戴安娜·长在这个浪漫喜剧中演出.)

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return ((殺手三分半鐘))
programme.desc: As Wong Hei, a slick assassin, zeroes in on a millionaire named Shek, little does he expect to find himself the target of someone even more dangerous. (作为一个巧妙的刺客, 海集中在一个名叫谢克的百万富翁, 他不想发现自己是更危险的人的目标.)

programme.title: Mr Funny Bone ((老夫子))
programme.desc: Whenever Mr. Funny Bone travels about with his sidekick Big Potato, he often gets involved in all manner of charming comic mishaps. (哥先生和他的助手大一起旅行时,他经常卷入各种迷人的漫画意外.)

programme.title: The Battle Wizard ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: The peace-loving prince of the Dali nation turns out to be the target for vengeance because of an old romantic feud. (达利民族的爱和平王子,由于有着古老的浪漫架,)

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Hong Kong ((血溅塘西))
programme.desc: Helmed by four Best Actors and set in Hong Kong in the 1970s, this exciting action film charts how the ICAC dealt with corruption within the police force in its early stages of establishment. (经过四位最佳演员的帮助, 故事发生在香港,)

programme.title: Band Four (第四乐队)
programme.desc: An aspiring singer reunites with her estranged guitarist father, and along with other family members, they unite to support each other through their love for music. (一位想唱歌的女歌手与她离乡的吉他手父亲重聚,)

programme.title: The Wandering Earth 2 ((流浪地球2))
programme.desc: Set as a prequel, when the sun was found to be dying, humans build enormous engines on the Earths surface to find a new home. To save the world, a group of young people decide to step forth. (作为一个预集,当发现太阳正在死亡时,人类在地球表面建造了巨大的引擎,)

programme.title: The Sparring Partner ((正义回廊))
programme.desc: A top-rated film based on a true case in Hong Kong, it tells of a young man who plots with his friend to murder dismember his parents, resulting in a highly controversial court case.

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate ((龙虎门))
programme.desc: Tiger Wong is ambushed after taking the Lousha Plaque, but is saved by his brother and also befriends Turbo Shek. To avenge the death of Dragon Gate masters, the trio vow to defeat Lousha Clan leader. (虎王被罗莎牌夺走后陷入伏地,但被他的兄弟救了,并成为土布谢克的朋友.为了报复龙门主人的死亡,三人誓言要击败罗莎部落领袖.)

programme.title: The Exodus ((苍穹之法芙娜 EXODUS))
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fong and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men. (一个低级警察发现一群女性,包括他的上司,Fong夫人和他的妻子,)

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette ((手卷烟))
programme.desc: In this Golden Horse winner starring Gordon Lam, a retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian drug mule. (在这个主演戈登·兰的金马奖得主,一位退休的英国-中国士兵成为一个三人团的猎人目标,)

programme.title: The Dumpling Queen ((水饺皇后))
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters after a failed marriage. She builds a dumpling stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises to become the citys renowned Dumpling Queen. (在1970年代,和她的两个女儿在失败的婚姻后搬到香港.她在万夏码头建造了一间饼摊,成为城市著名的饼女王.)

programme.title: Behind the Shadows ((阴守忍者))
programme.desc: A private detective uncovers his wifes betrayal during a case. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case, only to find the subject murdered, and revealing a string of serial killings. (一个私人侦探在一个案件中发现了他的妻子背叛. 震惊后,他放弃了失踪案件,)

programme.title: Measure In Love ((他年她日))
programme.desc: A massive quake splits the world into two zones with different time speeds. Medical student An Qing meets a boy named Shu Zai, yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged. (一场大规模的地震将世界分为两个不同时间速度的地区。 医科学生安清遇到了一个叫舒宰的男孩,但每次团聚,他都会很快长大,而她没有变化。)

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins ((十月围城))
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty. (获8项HKFA奖,其中包括全明星演员,这部电影描绘了一支精英团队在香港守卫孙森博士,)

programme.title: Cape No. 7 ((海角七号))
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer tries to deliver seven old love letters attentioned to a Tomoko. As he falls in love with a young Japanese model also named Tomoko, he unravels their serendipitous connection. (一位台湾歌手试图向一个莫科传递七封古老的爱情信.当他爱上一个名叫莫科的年轻日本模特时,他发现了他们的偶然联系.)

programme.title: The Sorcerer and the White Snake ((白蛇传说))
programme.desc: Charlene Choi Eva Huang star as beautiful snake demons who venture into the human world, incurring the wrath of Jet Lis authoritarian monk.

programme.title: Death Stranding ((死亡搁浅))
programme.desc: The Police and gambling association team up to overhaul underground gambling by auctioning new casino licenses. This unveils the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs... (警方和博协会将通过拍卖新场许可证,共同改革地下博.)

programme.title: Table for Six ((还是觉得你最好))
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table. (三个兄弟住在他们已故父母继承的家里. 长哥坚持每晚一起吃饭,)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: Winner of 9 awards at the 32nd Hong Kong Film Awards! When a police van is hijacked, Deputy Commissioner M.B Lee launches a rescue operation codenamed Cold War. (获第32届香港电影奖9项奖项的获奖者!)

programme.title: Call Me Agent ((我要做特務))
programme.desc: Miu Ling, who dreams of becoming a secret agent, accidentally rescues an injured spy. He agrees to make her his apprentice, turning her upside down as she goes on madcap adventures. (梦想成为一个秘密特工的灵意外地救出了一个受伤的间. 他同意让她成为他的学徒,)

programme.title: Bursting Point ((爆裂点))
programme.desc: A failed drug raid leaves an undercover cop trapped and a drug lord vowing to seek revenge. Senior Police Inspector Li resorts to blackmailing a drug dealer with his daughter to arrest the drug lord. (一次失败的毒品突袭让一名秘密警察陷入困境,一名毒品子发誓要报复.)

programme.title: Always Have Always Will ((原来时光都记得))
programme.desc: A struggling young man encounters a spirited girl and embarks on an uncertain journey. Together they share joys and sorrows, supporting each other through highs and lows, bringing light to darkness.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident ((生きてみたいもう一度 新宿バス放火事件))
programme.desc: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet, in this sprawling action drama. (一场简单的中国移民工资 一场针对世界上最强大的犯罪组织的 一场危险的战争 在这场无休止的行动剧中)

programme.title: Musee Hoangho Paiho Timeless Ancient Structures the Temple of Heaven
programme.desc: Prestige Chinese documentary production, tackling serious subjects with the best cinematography, editing, and all round production values with a unique Chinese perspective. (位中国纪录片制作,以最好的影视,编辑和具有独特的中国视角的全面生产价值来解决严的主题.)

programme.title: Restaging Chinese Opera Ep02
programme.desc: A documentary series showcasing the history of China and its people. (展示中国及其人民的历史.)

programme.title: In Search of Ancient China Tales of the Xia Dynasty Ep02
programme.desc: A documentary series featuring historical and archaeological exploration. (一部纪录片系列,涉及历史和考古探索.)

programme.title: Reunion Dinner, the Essence of Four SIII Foodwise Ep02
programme.desc: Food connects people! A feast for the eyes that spotlights the cuisines of China in a way thats bound to set the mouths of the whole globe watering! (食物连接着人们! 一个眼睛盛宴,以一种方式突出中国的美食,)

programme.title: The Journey of Innovation Ep02
programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick! (纪录片系列讲述中国年轻人,)

programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: Chinas Pinocchio Adventure ((Quanzhou Puppet Theater: Chinas 木偶奇遇记 Adventure))
programme.desc: A well-crafted collage of selected short documentaries telling stories about all aspects of China! People, technology, culture, and wildlife, all are showcased in Internet-friendly form. (精心制作的短片纪录片,讲述了中国各个方面的故事!)

programme.title: The Song of the Grand Canal Ep04 ((The Song of 大运河 Ep04))
programme.desc: Documentaries in this slot are rebroadcasts of our most-viewed and most popular stories of the season. They feature important social, economic, environmental affecting lives nationwide. (据此,该片中的纪录片是我们本季最受欢迎的故事的重播.)

programme.title: Chinese Dragon Boat Ep01 (中国龙船Ep01)
programme.desc: A well-crafted collage of selected short documentaries telling stories about all aspects of China! People, technology, culture, and wildlife, all are showcased in Internet-friendly form. (精心制作的短片纪录片,讲述了中国各个方面的故事!)

programme.title: Oriental Medicine Haiyang Big Yangko Dance Ep03
programme.desc: Real life stories told from the personal perspective. Moving, dramatic, sorrows and joys, expressed emphatically and expressed quietly. Watch closely to see and understand the real China as it is lived. (故事讲述了真实的生活,从个人角度讲述. 动作,戏剧性,悲伤和喜悦,强调和静地表达.)

programme.title: The Foreigner ((英伦对决))
programme.desc: Businessman with a buried past seeks justice when his daughter is killed in an act of terrorism. A cat-and-mouse conflict ensues with a government official, whose past may hold clues to the killers identities. (经理在一个被埋葬的过去寻求正义,当他的女儿在恐怖主义行为中被杀时.)

programme.title: Black Water: Abyss ((绝命鳄口))
programme.desc: Trapped in a flooded cave, a group of adventurers fighting for survival realise they have another thing to worry about: a pack of hungry crocodiles. (陷入一个淹没的洞穴中, 一群为了生存而战的冒险家意识到他们还有别的问题:)

programme.title: The 355 ((特工355))
programme.desc: When a top-secret weapon falls into mercenary hands, a wild-card C.I.A. agent joins forces with three international agents on a mission to retrieve it. (当一个高度机密的武器落入雇佣军手中时,一个的CIA特工与三个国际特工团结起来,)

programme.title: The Perfect Weapon ((未来杀手))
programme.desc: In the not so distant future, society is controlled by the powerful State and a dictator known as the Director. Condor works as a hitman for the State, but a reunion with someone he thought was dead forces him to consider who his enemies really are. (在不远的未来,社会由强大的国家和一个名为"总监"的独裁者控制.康多为国家工作为一名杀手,但与他认为已经死了的人相聚,迫使他考虑他的敌人是谁.)

programme.title: The Humanity Bureau ((人类办事处))
programme.desc: A dystopian thriller set in the year 2030 that sees the world in a permanent state of economic recession and facing serious environmental problems as a result of global warming. (剧情:世界经济处于永久衰退状态,)

programme.desc: Like in fairy tale. A dreamy girl or young woman in a cottage. Cockroaches seem to be the only thing hampering her. (像童话说中的样子,一个梦幻少女或一个小屋里的年轻女人.)

programme.desc: In a fictional American desert town circa 1955, the Junior StargazerSpace Cadet convention is about to be spectacularly upended by world-changing events. (在1955年美国的一个虚构的沙漠小镇 星际太空校友会 即将被世界变化事件 大大提升)

programme.title: Jurassic World ((侏罗纪世界：混沌理论))
programme.desc: Jurassic World has been fully operational for a number of years, fulfilling the vision that John Hammond had more than 20 years ago. Unfortunately, the public has become disinterested in a dinosaur amusement park, which leads to a team of scientists designing a genetically-enhanced hybrid dinosaur, the Indominus Rex, to boost attendance rates - a decision that ends up backfiring in a catastrophic (尤拉斯世界已经在运行中多年,实现了约翰·哈蒙德20多年前的愿景.不幸的是,公众对恐龙娱乐园已经失去了兴趣,这导致科学家们设计了一种基因改进的混合恐龙,Indominus Rex,以提高出席率.)

programme.title: Violent Night ((暴力之夜))
programme.desc: When an elite team of mercenaries breaks into a family compound on Christmas Eve, a disgruntled Santa Claus must take them out to save both the hostages and his Holiday. (当一个精英的雇佣军团队在圣诞节前夕入侵家庭的建筑物时,一个不满意的圣诞老人必须把他们带走,)

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his fathers death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the Toad Stance and accidentally unveils his true identity...

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the familys fortune.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends help.

programme.title: The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: The Chinese Navy is attempting to defend its coastline from a Japanese attack, they send their commando unit led by Cui Hsia into the mainland to enlist help to thwart the Japanese before they attack. The commandos enlist the help of Song San and Shiao Liu to kill the Japanese officers led by Shan Mao and destroy their attacking ships.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fangs fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Mings overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best. Its not so much the plot - a master swordsman protects a treasure chest on a dangerous journey - th

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop Sun Chien who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fte. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servants confusion, threatening the couples union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobras blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his fathers old rival.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Casino Tycoon. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kongs biggest stars

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Caos enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Beis concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandoras box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandoras Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bos magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named Wind and Cloud could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the others true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandoras Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Interrogation Cam - 5

programme.title: Interrogation Cam - 6

programme.title: Sleeping With A Killer S2 - Emmett Corrigan

programme.title: Beyond The Headlines: The Series - Shattered Families

programme.title: Beyond The Headlines: The Series - Toxic Love

programme.title: Booked: First Day In S2 - Bonnie Clyde

programme.desc: 第七集n天因殴打Ada而被起诉，Ada律师基认为这对Ada有利光怀疑天患有梦游病，见敏拒绝帮忙天，责她一向追求公平公正，却被憎恨蒙蔽敏出庭作证，Ada偷窃罪名不成立通和英知道敏与天的关系后，带着土产拜会天，还带天返围村，犹如衣锦还乡基与昕向光宣布拍拖，三人谈论如何才是相爱，基怂恿光测试敏会否为爱他而放弃高薪厚职天劝敏珍惜光，给光多点自由和尊重敏得悉天知道婚前协议书一事，质问光，光怒然反驳光决定跟朋友Simon合作搞多媒体公司，通表支持敏与昕一席话后，决定申请放大假，学习做家庭主妇，雄却表示刚推荐她当主任裁判官.

programme.title: 璀璨之城 今日知多D This City Never Sleeps Whats On Today
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛姜大卫饰在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤张智霖饰官孝君吴卓羲饰，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹张曦雯饰的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允高海宁饰成婚海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter

programme.title: 医生，你有病？ Who Heals the Healers?

programme.title: 天龙八部 Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: 金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，天龙八部更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材nn故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰杨佑宁饰大理世子段誉白澍饰少林小僧虚竹张天阳饰三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出情这一字带来的痛苦纠缠.

programme.desc: 金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，天龙八部更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材nn故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰杨佑宁饰大理世子段誉白澍饰少林小僧虚竹张天阳饰三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出情这一字带来的痛苦纠缠.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 世界观 今日知多D News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地两岸及国际重要新闻.

programme.title: 东张西望 Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 璀璨之城 This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛姜大卫饰在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤张智霖饰官孝君吴卓羲饰，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐孝贤一直视孝君为眼中钉，为瓦解孝君和其夫人王雪莹张曦雯饰的强大团伙，孝贤宣布与香港检控官洪海允高海宁饰成婚海允与雪莹本是闺密，出身于十月初五街，但雪莹为嫁入豪门，夺去海允的情人孝君孝贤就是要利用海允心中的仇恨，化成攻击孝君夫妇的利器在家族各人看似充满机心的环境中，孝君却坚守正义，奋力抵抗着孝贤的步步进逼.

programme.title: 九门 Mystic Nine
programme.desc: 九门讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局一桩401部队的神秘失踪事件，牵出百年尘封的惊天秘辛生死抉择兄弟之情门派担当与家国大义相互交织九门众人用热血和牺牲，守护家园，共渡难关.

programme.title: 医生，你有病？ Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: 你有病这三个字，医生说过无数次，但甚少听人对自己讲新闻部方东升团队再次出动，依然在寻人，寻找最不像病人的病人--医生他们平时处事快狠准，见惯生死，但当角色互换，成为病榻上的患者或照顾者，同样会逃避与焦虑大众眼中的神，终究是普通人，救人的医生如何自救？全新节目医生，你有病？，翻开医生那本难念的经，细看他们的脆弱与挣扎，还原白袍背后最真实的血肉人生.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 他来自江湖 Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Villa yang tenang itu sinarkan dengan kebahagiaan. Iskandar tidak menyangka Tengku Maria akan membawa Aisyah bertemu dengannya di Villa itu. Iskandar merasakan sesuatu yang aneh dalam hatinya namun dia tidak mampu melawan rasa kecewanya apabila Aisyah tidak mengingatinya. Di Villa itu, Aisyah berusaha untuk memujuk hati Iskandar. Segalanya telah dilakukan oleh Aisyah demi memohon maaf daripada seorang lelaki berstatus suami kepadanya. Aisyah sedar akan syurganya di bawah telapak kaki suami dan dia harus melutut memohon maaf daripada Iskandar meskipun ingtannya masih lemah. Tengku Maria mula tersenyum melihat adegan romantic mereka. Harapan dalam sebuah hubungan yang rumit itu dilihat semakin pulih dan cerah oleh Tengku Maria, namun dia tidak menduga, Iskandar mahu melepaskan Aisyah dan mahu Aisyah bersatu dengan Haziq. Dia menegaskan kepada Tengku Maria bahawa Hazqi menaruh cinta terhadap Aisyah sejak pertama kali mereka berjumpa. Tengku Mummy menegah apa yang dikatakan oleh Iskandar dan amat berharap Iskandar dapat menarik balik semula kata-katanya dan terus membina mahligai dia dan Aisyah. Tengku Maria sengaja meninggalkan Aisyah di Villa itu dan pulang ke Kuala Lumpur supaya mereka mempunyai ruang untuk memperbaiki hubungan seterusnya Iskandar dapat berfikir semula dan tidak melepaskan Aisyah.

programme.desc: Datin Jasmin meminta maaf atas segala yang dilakukan. Syarfan meragui kebaikan ibunya namun menerima semula Datin Jasmin di rumah. Keadaan Razali makin teruk. Nazarin membantu Alia menjaga Razali. Hana meletakkan racun di dalam minuman Antasya bagi membunuh anak di dalam kandungan Antasya. Hana mahu Syarfan menjadi miliknya. Datin Jasmin merancang membunuh Razali dan orang yang menghalangnya .

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Iskandar nekad untuk melepaskan Aisyah, dia membawa Aisyah ke tempat dia dan Aisyah di nikahkan. Aisyah berdebar menanti apa yang mahu di katakana oleh Iskandar. Iskandar meluahkan segalanyan dan mahu melafazkan cerai terhadap Aisyah. Aisyah merayu supaya lafaz itu tidak diteruskan. Aisyah rebah sebelum lafaz cerai terlafaz. Iskandar mengeraskan hatinya untuk tidak mengasihani Aisyah, dia mahu meninggalkan Aisyah dan membiarkan Aisyah rebah di situ. Kenangan cinta Iskandar terhadap Aisyah muncul semula dan membuatkan Iskandar kembali sedar dan mendapatkan Aisyah. Doktor menasihati Iskandar untuk tidak memberi sebarang tekanan kepada Aisyah jika mahu ingatan Aisyah pulih dan yang penting perlu beri ruang dan juga masa buat Aisyah. Iskandar berasa marah dengan dirinya sendiri atas keputusan yang dilakukan. Iskandar membawa Aisyah berehat di Villa itu. Iskandar memaklumkan hal itu kepada Tengku Maria dan Tengku Maria sangat lega dengan keputusan Iskandar. Dia memaklumkan dia akan membuat semula rancangannya untuk majlis persandingan mereka. Aisyah minta Iskandar membawanya pulang ke kampong semula untuk menjemput keluarga Mak Su Ainin, Ros, dan menziarahi kubur kedua ibu bapanya. Aisyah juga minta Iskandar membawanya bertemu dengan keluarga Rokiah dan keluarga Anim.

programme.desc: Pasangan pengantin baru, Gendis dan Joel, yang terpaksa dikuarantin di hotel selama tujuh hari selepas pulang berbulan madu. Hubungan mereka diuji apabila gangguan daripada bekas kekasih Joel mencetuskan rasa cemburu dan pertengkaran hebat akibat emosi Gendis yang sensitif.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Iskandar nekad untuk melepaskan Aisyah, dia membawa Aisyah ke tempat dia dan Aisyah di nikahkan. Aisyah berdebar menanti apa yang mahu di katakana oleh Iskandar. Iskandar meluahkan segalanyan dan mahu melafazkan cerai terhadap Aisyah. Aisyah merayu supaya lafaz itu tidak diteruskan. Aisyah rebah sebelum lafaz cerai terlafaz. Iskandar mengeraskan hatinya untuk tidak mengasihani Aisyah, dia mahu meninggalkan Aisyah dan membiarkan Aisyah rebah di situ. Kenangan cinta Iskandar terhadap Aisyah muncul semula dan membuatkan Iskandar kembali sedar dan mendapatkan Aisyah. Doktor menasihati Iskandar untuk tidak memberi sebarang tekanan kepada Aisyah jika mahu ingatan Aisyah pulih dan yang penting perlu beri ruang dan juga masa buat Aisyah. Iskandar berasa marah dengan dirinya sendiri atas keputusan yang dilakukan. Iskandar membawa Aisyah berehat di Villa itu. Iskandar memaklumkan hal itu kepada Tengku Maria dan Tengku Maria sangat lega dengan keputusan Iskandar. Dia memaklumkan dia akan membuat semula rancangannya untuk majlis persandingan mereka. Aisyah minta Iskandar membawanya pulang ke kampong semula untuk menjemput keluarga Mak Su Ainin, Ros, dan menziarahi kubur kedua ibu bapanya. Aisyah juga minta Iskandar membawanya bertemu dengan keluarga Rokiah dan keluarga Anim.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Mummy Reborn
programme.desc: Apabila sekumpulan remaja dalam kemusnahan kewangan memutuskan untuk merompak kedai antik tempatan, mereka menemui sebuah kubur kayu lama yang mengandungi mayat Mumia dan azimat purba. Tetapi apa yang mereka tidak sedar adalah kubur ini terkutuk, dan apabila azimat itu dipisahkan daripada tuannya, dia akan melakukan apa sahaja untuk mendapatkannya kembali. Pencuri kita mesti menyelamatkan hari ini dan mengembalikan Mumia ke kuburnya sebelum terlambat untuk menyelamatkan dunia.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP6
programme.desc: Peristiwa ganjil menimbulkan persoalan, adakah ini sekadar histeria atau sesuatu yang benar-benar gelap?

programme.desc: Mengisahkan lima sahabat yang terlepas tren selepas terlalu lama berbincang di sebuah kafe berhampiran stesen. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad Que Haidar, penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Repeaters

programme.title: Rajawali
programme.desc: Rajawali mengisahkan penggodam yang diupah Komang untuk memecah sistem komputer ciptaan Arwin, namun program itu merupakan ritual ilmu hitam digital. Arwin dirasuk oleh program tersebut, manakala Komang terjerumus ke kegelapan.

programme.title: Black S2 EP8
programme.desc: Black dan Sofia keluar janji temu seharian. Tapi kebahagiaan hilang apabila 007 dan 416 membawa berita buruk buat Black - orang atasan tidak gembira dengan kurangnya kemajuan yang dibuat oleh Black. Borhan telah membuat penemuan yang mengerikan dan dia menyedari yang dia akhirnya telah menemui bukti muktamad. Semuanya tertuju ke arah seseorang yang dia syak selama ini, tapi dia membuat satu lagi penemuan yang sangat mengejutkan.

programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Sarawak, sebuah legenda kuno tentang Raya Emas telah diwarisi turun-temurun. Tapi apabila mata-mata tamak mula mengarah kepadanya, satu perjalanan yang menguji iman dan keberanian bakal terungkai.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP16
programme.desc: Apabila Aunty Vi merupakan satu-satunya juri dalam perbicaraan pembunuhan yang percaya bahawa defendan tidak bersalah, McCall secara rahsia menyiasat kes itu untuk mencari bukti bahawa naluri Vi adalah betul.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP3

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langityang mampu mengawal minda manusiaenam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: Dont Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: Police Story II
programme.desc: Pegawai polis hebat Hong Kong itu perlu menghentikan sekumpulan pengebom yang melakukan pemerasan, sementara musuh-musuh daripada filem Police Story 1985 pula mahu membalas dendam.

programme.title: Siku 12: Langkah Derhaka
programme.desc: Seorang bapa telah merahsiakan ilmu persilatan yang telah lama dipelajari daripada anaknya kerana sejarah hitam yang dilaluinya. Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN HSUAN JESSICA HESTER and KOT KWOK KWONG CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG WANG CHIEH, DAVE, who is now MANs colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. programme.title: Who Heals the Healers? Whats On Today ((Who Heals the Healers? 即将上映电影))
programme.desc: Doctors have said Youre sick countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news departments Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the patient who least resembles a patientthe doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, Doctor, Are You Sick?, delves into the difficult reality of doctors lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot ((中文))
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals (了解当地习俗和文化的最佳方式是深入旅行,探索城市的每个角落,徒步旅行,探索整个城市的每个角落,欣赏沿途的风景,发现当地的生活和文化,迎接出乎意料的意外和挑战。 什乔里和蔡清春被一个制作团队引诱到台湾拍摄一个真实的节目。 从高雄机场开始,他们征服了300多公里,从太南到台北,在8天里访问了8个城市,每天只有1 000图亚,两个城市用他们的大脑解决交通和食品等问题,同时完成各种任务,甚至用有限的资源换房,他们不得不使用任何必要的手段实现其目标。)

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps ((璀璨之城))
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam John Chiang is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In Julian Cheung and Kun Hao Kuan Ron Ng, to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying Kelly Cheung, Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan Samantha Ko. Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wans boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wans hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao Ins relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how! (李建丁师,坚强的老师丁,无疑是武术的士,但他厨艺技巧也令人印象深刻!丁师与精明的食品熟练者坦尤宁合作建立了士丁厨房.每集都带着观众去寻找他们最喜欢的食材,丁师亲自做各种特色的菜,和甜点,提供怀旧的堪敦式美食!如何以负担得起的价格做真实的传统烤?如何控制鱼时的热量和时间?秋冬,许多人喜欢香水米,特别是脆的米皮.但你有没有见过士丁的米米两侧都显示了米米的米技巧吗?看看看!)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps ((璀璨之城))
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam John Chiang is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In Julian Cheung and Kun Hao Kuan Ron Ng, to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying Kelly Cheung, Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan Samantha Ko. Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wans boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wans hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao Ins relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Mystic Nine ((九门))
programme.desc: In 1933, a mysterious ghost train arrives in Changsha, prompting military commander Zhang Qishan to investigate a hidden mine containing ancient secrets targeted by Japanese forces. Joining forces with opera singer Er Yue Hong and hotel heiress Yin Xinyue, Qishan and the citys powerful Mystic Nine families must navigate deadly underground traps to solve a century-old mystery and protect their nation from invasion.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said Youre sick countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news departments Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the patient who least resembles a patientthe doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, Doctor, Are You Sick?, delves into the difficult reality of doctors lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG WANG CHIEH, DAVE, who is now MANs colleague. Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps ((璀璨之城))
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam John Chiang is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In Julian Cheung and Kun Hao Kuan Ron Ng, to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying Kelly Cheung, Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan Samantha Ko. Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wans boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wans hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao Ins relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. (儿童节目"手上升"鼓励孩子们勇敢地问问题,表达自己,追求自己的目标!子家族成员加入主持人表演短短剧,陪伴所有人享受快乐的时刻.节目还将有各种儿童歌曲,让孩子们一起唱歌,同时学习实用生活知识.)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))

In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Mystic Nine Whats On Today ((Mystic Nine 即将上映电影))
programme.desc: Mystic Nine tells the story of Zhang Qishan William Chan and Wu Laogou Joseph Zeng joining forces with Huo Xiangu Chen Yao and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers
programme.desc: Doctors have said Youre sick countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news departments Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the patient who least resembles a patientthe doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, Doctor, Are You Sick?, delves into the difficult reality of doctors lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping ((港女野人))
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?
