programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong ((血溅塘西))
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun. (警官和三方领袖团结起来取数十亿美元的. 作为一个律师加入他的朋友在ICAC调查他们的勾结和打击腐败,正义人和邪恶之间的战斗刚刚开始.)

programme.title: Band Four (第四乐队)
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music. (在她母亲去世后,一个叫Band Four的独立乐队的一位有抱负的歌手与她离散的吉他手父亲团聚。 与其同父异母的姐姐和9岁的儿子一起,新团聚的家庭聚集在一起,通过对音乐的爱和热情相互支持。)

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II ((流浪地球2))
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earths surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: The Sparring Partner ((正义回廊))
programme.desc: Adapted from a sensational 2013 parricide in Hong Kong, a young man partners with his friend to murder and dismember his parents. Pleading not guilty, the defendants play the devil and idiot game, while the defense attorneys turn on each other. Meanwhile, heated debates emerge inside the jury room, where nine jurors grapple with the truth.

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate ((龙虎门))
programme.desc: Adapted from a famous Hong Kong comic, Tiger Wong is ambushed after he unwittingly took the Lousha Plaque but is saved by his brother Dragon Wong. They also befriended Turbo Shek during the fight and the trio forms a brotherhood. To avenge the death of the Dragon Gate masters, they train and vow to defeat Shibumi, the leader of Lousha Clan. (龙虎王从著名的香港漫画改编而来,在无意中攻占卢沙广场后遭到伏击,但获其兄龙王救赎。 在战斗中,他们也成为Turbo Shek的朋友,三合会形成兄弟关系。 为了为龙门大师的死报仇,他们训练并发誓击败卢沙氏族领袖Shibumi。)

programme.title: The Exodus ((苍穹之法芙娜 EXODUS))
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men. (一个低级警察发现了一群妇女,包括他的上司方方女士和妻子,密谋消灭男人的世界。)

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette ((手卷烟))
programme.desc: A retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian man who carries a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live together, the two men transcend conflicts and cultural differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood. (一位退休的英中士兵在抓走一个携带一袋被盗毒品的南亚青年男子时成为三合会追捕的目标。 两人被迫共同生活,他们超越冲突和文化差异,在这个充满忠诚和兄弟情谊的壮观故事中形成美丽的友谊。)

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The ((水饺皇后))
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the citys renowned Dumpling Queen. (在1970年代,和她的两个女儿在失败的婚姻后搬到香港.从一个洗碗机和奇怪的工作工作者开始,她努力生存.)

programme.title: Behind the Shadows ((阴守忍者))
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wifes betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken. (欧阳二等兵侦探在调查期间发现了妻子的背叛。他因惊吓而放弃了一个失踪人员案件。不久之后,失踪的人就死了。陈督察怀疑一个连环杀手可能逍遥法外。 欧阳必须用他的能力在另一个人被杀死之前阻止凶手。)

programme.title: Measure in Love ((他年她日))
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate. (一场大地震将世界分裂为两个时间以不同速度流动的区域。 在医疗救援任务中,安青学生与舒宰会面,并开始与众不同寻常的纽带。 然而,每次重聚,他都会在她没有变化的情况下迅速衰老,迫使他们面对时间、距离和命运挑战的爱情。)

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins ((十月围城))
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Dailys Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army. (1906年10月15日,中国革命领袖孙森返回香港,再次推翻清朝.商人李和中国日报总监陈安排了五名保卫人来保护孙先生 - - 这些都是非常出色的战士,准备好与清杀军进行激烈的战斗.)

programme.title: Cape No. 7 ((海角七号))
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer tries to deliver seven old love letters attentioned to a Tomoko. As he falls in love with a young Japanese model also named Tomoko, he unravels their serendipitous connection. (一位台湾歌手试图向一个莫科传递七封古老的爱情信.当他爱上一个名叫莫科的年轻日本模特时,他发现了他们的偶然联系.)

programme.title: The Sorcerer The White Snake ((白蛇传说))
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snakes true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Death Stranding ((死亡搁浅))
programme.desc: To overhaul the underground gambling industry, the police join hands with the gambling association to crack down on illegal casinos. They auction off new casino licenses to regulate the industry, but this results in an upheaval in the gambling world, unveiling the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: Table for Six ((还是觉得你最好))
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six! (在喜剧中,三个兄弟居住在一个从已故父母继承下来的家中。 长兄坚持说,他们作为一个家庭每晚在家里吃晚饭,但是当她们女朋友也一起来的时候,紧张也开始加剧。 爱、友谊、嫉妒和复杂的关系在这张桌子的菜单上排了六个!)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation. (警方专员离开香港后,便发生劫持警车事件。 李副局长领导了一个代号为冷战的救援行动。 肖恩副局长副局长西恩(Sean)试图控制李(Lee),因为他认为李(Lee)因儿子被扣为人质在情感上受到影响,但他的所作所为最终威胁到他们的声誉。)

programme.title: Call Me Agent ((我要做特務))
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Bursting Point ((爆裂点))
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yangs rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun! (邦督察长派明警官卧底去贩毒集团以取代毒枭杨。一次失败的突袭引发杨氏复仇的愤怒。 与此同时,制毒的尹秀被迫与警方合作,并为杨设了一个陷阱。 警方和毒贩的战斗才刚刚开始!)

programme.title: Always Have Always Will ((原来时光都记得))
programme.desc: A struggling young man unexpectedly meets an optimistic, spirited young girl, and together they set off on an uncertain, soul-healing journey. Through lifes highs and lows, they stand by each other in hardship, their companionship mending the wounds they carry and reigniting hope in lifes darkest moments.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident ((生きてみたいもう一度 新宿バス放火事件))
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival. (中国移民铁头党在东京和移民同胞一起为生存而奋斗,然后才开始建立新的三合会。 正如他获得合法居留权并决定离开黑社会一样,警察镇压和背叛也迫使他回到一场无情的生存斗争中。)

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins ((摩登土佬))
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world. (音乐喜剧是关于一个年轻人芬 和他的兄弟汉堡 在广告界找到爱和成功)

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate ((神雕侠侣))
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his fathers death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the Toad Stance and accidentally unveils his true identity

programme.title: Hong Kong 73 ((香港'73))
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home... (在1973年,香港恒盛指数达到非凡的峰值,)

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats ((南斗官三斗北少爷))
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the familys fortune.

programme.title: The Three Smiles ((三笑))
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends help. (在家里工作,他伪装为仆人.在向她透露自己的真实身份时不相信胡,只有当他透露自己的才能和朋友帮助时才会爱上他.)

programme.title: The Naval Commandos ((海军突击队))
programme.desc: The Chinese Navy is attempting to defend its coastline from a Japanese attack, they send their commando unit led by Cui Hsia into the mainland to enlist help to thwart the Japanese before they attack. The commandos enlist the help of Song San and Shiao Liu to kill the Japanese officers led by Shan Mao and destroy their attacking ships.

programme.title: The Swordmates ((燕娘))
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her

programme.title: The Fighting Fool ((夺棍))
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown. (著名的功夫波尔师红,被一个恶棍绑架.他的门徒孟誓言要救他.在路上,孟遇到了一个贪但伟大的武术艺术家,同意加入他救援.尽管他们两个性格极其不同,但他们设法团结起来和恶棍在最后的对抗.)

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake ((寒煙翠))
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget. (一位年轻的女孩陈是被离婚的父母送走的。 在长斯农场上,她遇到了他们的两个儿子、最小的女儿和一个年轻的艺术家,并且和他们度过了她永远不会忘记的夏天。)

programme.title: Dirty Ho ((臭臭和脏脏))
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot... (王师父,实际上是第十一位王子,扮演着古董的知识分子,以隐藏他的真实身份.)

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil ((托德与邪恶之书))
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fangs fianc and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him

programme.title: Forever Diamonds ((007：金刚钻))
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: Till the End of Time ((直到永远))
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Mings overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra ((人蛇鼠))
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere. (惊人的的是,标题蛇不是恐怖的预言者,而是电影的英雄.这个美德的蛇嗅出炸弹,战斗帮派,战斗杀死婴儿的动物,甚至对付一个双重的女人.)

programme.title: The Delinquent ((斯文败类))
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it. (这是一个成年故事,描绘了1960年代香港低阶级的困境青年和他们面临的社会问题.王是一个热心和叛逆的青少年,)

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies ((女子公寓))
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death (与死亡的约会)
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best. Its not so much the plot - a master swordsman protects a treasure chest on a dangerous journey - that makes this great, but what Sun does with it, inspiring the cast and crew to some of their finest work.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung ((乾隆皇奇遇记))
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him? (龙皇帝不知名地与他的人民混在一起,了解他们的需要. 在路上,他遇到了许多奇怪的事情,包括被捕和几乎被砍了头.)

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer ((江湖了断))
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop Sun Chien who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time. (追逐杀手的魅力在于五毒团队长期以来的团结,洛孟和孙罗孟,谁扮演了中国大陆犯罪逃犯到香港寻找更好的生活,)

programme.title: The Bride Napping ((花田错))
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fte. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servants confusion, threatening the couples union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return ((殺手三分半鐘))
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination. (专业杀手路易在完成杀死香港帮派大老板的任务后前往马来西亚.他的下一个目标是一个新郎在中国街酒店举办婚宴.)

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone ((老夫子))
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags! (加入奇幻小说中的蛋先生,他试图赢得一个丽的女人的心. 随着骑行,他的忠实的助手是大土豆先生,一个坚强的家伙,他永远陷入愚蠢的意外.)

programme.title: The Battle Wizard ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobras blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his fathers old rival. (达利王子尤对武术没有任何了解,但离开宫殿前往武术世界.他遇到了一个蛇巫婆和他的神秘的半妹妹.通过各种不幸,尤通过吸着子的血和吞下魔术获得了无敌的力量,最终击败了他的父亲的老对手.)

programme.title: The Great Indian Kitchen
programme.desc: Post her marriage, a woman tries to fit into the conventional mould that society has prescribed for married women. But somewhere along the way, she starts feeling that this is not the life she wants.

programme.title: Thirumanam
programme.desc: Very much concerned about his familys financial status, Arivudainambi is unhappy with the way his sisters wedding to a wealthy man is being done.

programme.title: Kennedy Club
programme.desc: Savarimuthu, an ex-soldier, falls sick while training the womens kabaddi team of his village. Soon, a former student named Muruganandham is chosen to take his place.

programme.title: J Baby
programme.desc: Volatile mother leaves family without notice. Sons embark on journey to find her, bringing family drama to light.

programme.title: Goli Soda
programme.desc: In Koyambedu market, four carefree coolie boys start a mess to earn respect and identity, transforming their lives and friendships along the way.

programme.title: Pookie
programme.desc: Kailash and Aazhis six-year bond shatters when a routine argument escalates into a heated fight, turning into a life-changing moment that alters their relationship forever.

programme.title: Bimbisara
programme.desc: Betrayed by his brother, an ancient evil emperor is trapped in a mirror and transported to the modern world, where he desperately searches for the mirror to return to his kingdom.

programme.title: KGF: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mothers wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

programme.title: Inji Iduppazhagi
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston plays a young woman trying to find a husband but cant because shes overweight. She learns to love her body and leads an awareness campaign to fight against a slimness center.

programme.desc: A journalist and colleagues investigate Covelone Estate, rumored haunted. Their perilous exploration uncovers dangerous truths, threatening their lives as suspense and fear escalate.

programme.desc: A street musician discovers he can glimpse couples futures when they kiss. When a vision reveals his love, he races to defy destiny and change it.

programme.desc: Rajini Murugan, an unemployed youth, falls in love with Karthika, his cousin. But Karthikas father opposes the match.

programme.title: Sivalinga
programme.desc: Raheem gets killed when he tries to save a blind man in a train. When the police close the case stating suicide, Raheems girlfriend asks Shivalingeshwaran, a CID officer, to investigate the death.

programme.title: Gladiators ((角斗士传奇))
programme.desc: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

programme.title: Gladiators ((角斗士传奇))
programme.desc: Head to Americas far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

programme.title: Macro Worlds ((宏观世界))
programme.desc: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the worlds animals are beetles. They have conquered almost every corner and every habitat on the planet and they have survived every global disaster. What is it that makes them so successful? (甲壳虫在地球居住了超过2.4亿年,科学家们知道有38万种甲虫,每年发现数百种新物种。世界四分之一的动物是甲虫。它们征服了地球上几乎每一个角落和每个栖息地,生存了每一次全球灾难。是什么使它们如此成功?)

programme.title: Arabian Seas ((阿拉伯海))
programme.desc: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild ((无垠的狂野蓝海))
programme.desc: The Wild Coast of South Africa stretches for 170 miles. Here, the waters of the Indian and the Atlantic converge, forcing powerful waves towards the shoreline. This is where the Mozambique-based manta ray researcher Andrea Marshall hopes to conduct her first-ever manta ray expedition within South Africas borders...

programme.title: Bugs That Rule The World ((虫临天下))
programme.desc: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas ((未发掘之景观))
programme.desc: Dive under Mexicos Yucatn rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas ((未发掘之景观))
programme.desc: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild ((无垠的狂野蓝海))
programme.desc: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the worlds largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defenceless against reckless overfishing. Two of Mozambiques leading marine researchers, Andrea Marshall and Nakia Cullain, set out to find one of the oceans most secretive animals and protect its most well known, before its too late.

programme.title: Supersenses (超感觉)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Enchanted Forests ((仙境森林的秘密))
programme.desc: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas ((未发掘之景观))
programme.desc: Dive under Mexicos Yucatn rainforest into an elaborate network of flooded caves called cenotes. Learn how underground rivers feed the waterless surface on their way to the sea, supporting legions of bats, howler monkeys, and more curious species.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas ((未发掘之景观))
programme.desc: Find surprises in Mexicos untamed Sierra Gorda biosphere. Prowl the arid semi-desert with horned lizards, marvel at axolotl regeneration in the river-fed foothills, and soar with monarch butterflies in the treetops high above a hazy cloud forest.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild ((无垠的狂野蓝海))
programme.desc: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the worlds largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defenceless against reckless overfishing. Two of Mozambiques leading marine researchers, Andrea Marshall and Nakia Cullain, set out to find one of the oceans most secretive animals and protect its most well known, before its too late.

programme.title: Supersenses (超感觉)
programme.desc: Vision - its how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision. (地球的每一个物种都是视觉故事中的一章。这集故事从模糊的初星到脑中发光的螺旋眼。)

programme.title: Macro Worlds ((宏观世界))
programme.desc: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the worlds animals are beetles. They have conquered almost every corner and every habitat on the planet and they have survived every global disaster. What is it that makes them so successful? (甲壳虫在地球居住了超过2.4亿年,科学家们知道有38万种甲虫,每年发现数百种新物种。世界四分之一的动物是甲虫。它们征服了地球上几乎每一个角落和每个栖息地,生存了每一次全球灾难。是什么使它们如此成功?)

programme.title: Arabian Seas ((阿拉伯海))
programme.desc: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule The World ((虫临天下))
programme.desc: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia is determined to sell more Young Pioneers cookies than anybody else in her troupe - especially Francine. It turns out to be harder than she thought it would be, but with a little perseverance and ingenuity, Olivia manages to do her personal best.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When Mrs. Hogenmullers class plans a Parents Night, Olivia thrills her classmates when she suggests the idea of a carnival. In her own special way Olivia oversees the construction of games and amusements, and when the night of the carnival arrives, she still has a few surprises up her sleeve.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After seeing Grandma perform an impromptu magic show, Olivia begins practicing her own magic tricks. She doesnt have much success, until she manages to make herself disappear for Ian and Julian. They cant figure out how shes done it, but Ian doesnt care. He just wants his big sister back!

programme.title: Caspers Scare School
programme.desc: Substitute Gargoyle - Casper accidentally breaks a Gargoyles ear, and the Gargoyle jumps on the opportunity by faking so he doesnt have to work anymore! The headmasters make Casper take the Gargoyles place while it is convalescing, and ends up doing all sorts of boring chores while the gargoyle takes it real easy. On top of that Ra and Mantha are forced to attend the smallest requests and theyre furious, its clear hes faking everything and is the laziest lump of stone in the world. Casper and his friends now have to prove the fakery and get themselves out of being substitute gargoyles! Ship in a Bottle - Casper has built a model of Cappys ship inside a bottle for a school competition. Thatch steals it and discovers that the bottle is actually magical: with is he can control Cappys pirate galleon like a magical remote control. The boat is shaken in all directions and ends up being uncontrollably projected towards Deedstown. Casper must break the spell and save the boat from a disaster.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School
programme.desc: Jack out of the Box - Jimmy asks Casper to come to a toy swap in town and Casper brings a jack-in-a-box that hes found in the Scare School attic. In fact the Jack is a sneaky little character dead set on taking his revenge on Scare School for being locked away all these years.. The Jack first hypnotizes Jimmy, and then other Deedstown kids before taking his little army to Scare School in order to confront Alder Dash. Will Casper manage to trap the Jack and get Jimmy out of danger? Casper Meets Super Choc - A spaceship has crashed in the Forbidden Forest! A strange little boy wearing a mask comes out of it and introduces himself to Casper. He says his name is Super Choc, that he comes from another planet and that his dream is to study at Scare School, the good reputation of which has travelled all the way to his planet. Easier said than done! The little super-hero flunks the admission test to Scare School, and with Thatchs help he turns the teachers into chocolate statues and goes to Deedstown to spread terror! Casper must do everything he can to stop this evil duo and send this rebellious little super- hero back to his planet!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When the Dews Glitter Guide, Willow comes to check on the Dews progress, they feel like theyre failing to impress her, until Lola gets locked out of the apartment during a game of Hide-and-Seek and Dews work together to get her back inside. When the Dew Drops discover a time capsule in the park, they set out to find the mystery owner.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Phoebe convinces the Tooth Fairy to visit before Marcus has actually lost his tooth, the Dew Drops do everything in their power to make sure the tooth is out before she arrives! The Dews decide to hold a concert in the park for their animal friends, but cant find the time to practice.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: When one of Rikkis plants wont sing, Pixie and Juniper both tell their varying recollections of why the plant is suddenly silent. Kelp, Scallop, and Cruz have always thought that starfish did nothing but laze about but as they go about their day, the starfish goes through his own routine, completely unbeknownst to everyone else.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper look for the plant they think will cure her. Meanwhile Pixie wonders whether she can be cured at all!

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: When Mom is sick on a busy day at home, Tag offers to pick up the slack and take on her tasks for the day. Tag handles it at first, but when the responsibilities start to stack up, she realizes that being Mom is much harder than she thought. Tag and Scooch are excited to get to know Kit, who has organized a bunch of cat-ivities for the day. But when Kit realizes she accidentally scratched up Frank and Beanss tree, she, Tag and Scooch find a way to make it up to them.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: When Tag is frustrated living in a crowded house, and Scooch is bored in a quiet house, the two friends switch houses for the day. At first they both love their new lives. But as Scooch gets overwhelmed by all the activity at The Barker house, and Tag gets bored by the quiet life at the Poochs, they eagerly switch back before the day is done. When the Pawston Get Sox go on a losing streak, Tag and Scooch come up with the idea to have a team mascot. And Frank and Beans are the perfect fit! But when the two mascots start to clash over who gets the spotlight, Tag has to help save their friendship, and the big game!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders
programme.desc: Magnus and Axel unveil their new mechano-dragon. Its impressive at first, but the Riders set out to prove its no better than a bucket of bolts.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders
programme.desc: In need of some rest and relaxation, the Riders head out on vacation. But their supposedly perfect island getaway isnt quite what they hoped for.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild
programme.desc: Lala, whos grown into a froglet, is ready to finally join the gang on a big adventure in the city! But she relies on her water bowl to get around, and Gloria goes overboard in trying to protect her tiny friend in the big world- only to realize that she underestimated all Lala is capable of doing.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild
programme.desc: When a snowstorm blocks Kate from accessing the zoo, Melman decides to become substitute Kate and make sure the animals are cared for. But when the animals go wild in the snow, Melmans future-paramedic skills are put to the test during an outbreak of stubbed toes and boo-boos. programme.desc: 당신도 요리의 달인이 될 수 있다. 최고의 요리비결은 국내 최고의 요리전문가에게서 최고의 요리 비결만을 전수받을 수 있는 정통 요리 프로그램!

programme.title: 세계테마기행
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 마샤와 곰

programme.title: 극한직업

programme.desc: 축구를 사랑하는 여고생 비올라 존슨은 자신의 축구팀이 학교에서 해체되자, 쌍둥이 남매 세바스챤 대신 그가 다니는 사립 기숙고등학교의 축구팀에서 2주간 뛸 결심을 한다. 모두가 비올라를 세바스챤으로 생각하는 가운데, 그녀는 세바스챤의 룸메이트 듀크에게 사랑의 감정을 느끼게 되지만, 그녀의 사랑이 순탄치만은 않다. lt금발이 너무해gt의 작가와 lt왓어걸원츠gt의 아만다 바인즈, lt스텝업gt의 채닝 테이텀이 만들어내는 2007 최고의 로맨틱코미디!

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.
